summary: Sample job usage before every cgroup retirement (unit 7d)

rules.detail: Admission remains inactive; configuration remains the only source of limits.

compatibility.detail: Stop and abort share one retirement path: cgroup.kill, populated=0, unit-12 usage sample or typed counters-unavailable, then rmdir. The driver returns that sample, including for a never-released J. A vanished J reports counters-unavailable.

downtime.detail: No live behavior or deployment changes.

recovery.detail: Cleanup errors remain unresolved; no retry is introduced.
